name: Developer workflow (consumer)
description: How engineering works over the scm and ci interfaces, whichever provider is bound: a Recent builds card on Operations with a Re-run action, an Open pull requests panel on tasks, guidance on merges and builds, and pull-request review and failing-build triage skills. Pure content: no code, no egress.

repo.description: The repository the Recent builds card and the Open pull requests panel show.

guidance.title: Pull requests and merges
guidance.text: Every change reaches the default branch through a reviewed pull request. The author never reviews their own change; a merge needs green CI and runs only on an approved change record with two keys. Keep pull requests small enough to review in one sitting.

guidance.title: Builds
guidance.text: Recent builds are on the Operations dashboard. A red build on the default branch is fixed or reverted before new work merges; read the run logs before re-running, and re-run a flaky check once at most before treating it as a real failure.

actions.title: Re-run a build
